description: v0 pool session channel map (RESEARCH_PLAN.md 6.1). One recorder = one file per take. File channels are 0-based; the playback interface's inputs are in1 = file ch 0, in2 = file ch 1. Hydrophone channel_id is the ch<N> of every utt_id. Edit to match the rig on the day and keep the edited copy with the session (run_session.py plan copies it into session.json).
